Monarto Safari Resort
Nestled in the heart of pristine wilderness,
Monarto Safari Resort offers an unparalleled escape
into nature s embrace. Our destination combines
premium accommodation with authentic experiences,
creating memories that last a lifetime.
Experience breathtaking landscapes in

BOOK YOUR STAY
An escape from the everyday
With spacious and thoughtfully designed rooms and suites, indulgent dining, and a luxurious spa, Monarto Safari Resort is the ideal safari staycation. Whether it s a family getaway or romantic weekend, it serves as the perfect base for bringing you closer to the wild than ever before.

Stay at our Resort
Enjoy a memorable stay at Monarto Safari Resort. Our hotel boasts 78 guest rooms and suites plus 20 luxury safari tents, suitable for friends, couples and families.
Wake up to animals congregating around the waterhole or savour a beautiful sunset over the savannah. With King, Twin, Interconnecting and Accessible rooms and suites plus intimate luxury safari tents, we invite you to join us for a safari staycation.
Learn More
Dine at our Resort
Take a seat at Kutjera, our restaurant and bar showcasing stunning contemporary Australian cuisine. Each dish features locally sourced South Australian ingredients and produce, curate by our talented culinary team.
Kutjera Restaurant & Bar is open to our guests as well as the general public for breakfast, dinner and all day dining, seven day a week.
Learn More
Relax at our Resort
Marula Day Spa is our sanctuary. Drawing inspiration from the revered African Marula tree celebrated for its healing properties and symbolic vitality our name reflects a space rooted in life, balance and renewal.
Both Resort guests and the general public are invited to visit and explore our signature spa menu. Indulge in a relaxing massage, restorative facial, or simply take advantage of our beautiful Soak House.

Conservation Fund
Conservation is at the heart of Monarto Safari Park and Zoos SA’s mission. We donate a portion of every booking at our Resort to the Zoos SA Conservation Fund.
By staying at our Resort you are directly contributing to programs that ensure the ongoing survival of these amazing animals.
Learn more .
Accessibility
Monarto Safari Resort offers a number of facilities for guests with accessibility requirements.
We have accessible car parking close to the entry of the Resort, accessible bathrooms located within or close to our amenities (Restaurant, Day Spa, and Pool), pool hoists, and a number of accessible guest rooms available so you can make the most of your stay.

About - Monarto Safari Resort
Search for:
Search Results
About
Stay wild
Escape from the everyday at Monarto Safari Resort, nestled within Monarto Safari Park s
Wild Africa precinct in the picturesque Murraylands of South Australia. Guests are invited
to indulge in the serenity of their surroundings and witness the beauty of diverse species
as they roam the neighbouring plains.
Managed by Journey Beyond and working closely with Zoos SA, the first guests were
welcomed into Monarto Safari Resort s Hotel in 2025, followed by Safari Lodge in 2026.
A wild escape awaits
Designed to incorporate the natural beauty of the location, Monarto Safari Resort offers both premium and luxury accommodation.
Perfectly suited for families, groups and those looking for a casual staycation, the Resort s Hotel features 78 spacious guest rooms and suites, overlooking the neighbouring waterhole or offering beautiful sunset views, and two heated outdoor pools. Both guests and visitors alike are welcome to indulge at the stunning Marula Day Spa or enjoy a delicious African-inspired meal at Kutjera Restaurant & Bar .
For a more intimate and luxurious stay, Safari Lodge offers an all-inclusive experience for guests aged 15 years and above, making it ideal for friends, couples or solo escapes. Located adjacent to the Hotel, Safari Lodge is exclusive only to those staying. 20 luxury safari tents surround a central lodge which features a restaurant, bar, private dining space, outdoor lounge, swimming and plunge pools plus gym and pickleball court.
Sustainability
We re proud to have implemented a number of sustainability initiatives throughout the Hotel and Lodge and within the design, construction and general management of Monarto Safari Resort. These include but are not limited to:
Local indigenous planting throughout the landscaping, enabling the reduction of water needs and providing flora for the native wildlife and birdlife
Installation of energy saving room card readers to manage the energy consumption of lightning, air conditioning and other electrical items within occupied and vacant rooms
Solar panels on the roof and electric vehicle chargers in the car park
Double glazed windows and insulation throughout the walls and ceilings, low energy light fittings , and pool covers
Hardwood timber finishes throughout for greater strength and longevity, and solid timber decking and framework
Journey Beyond
Monarto Safari Resort is part of Journey Beyond , Australia s largest experiential tourism business. Journey Beyond provides guests with iconic travel experiences across Australia and New Zealand.
Journey Lightly
Journey Lightly is a promise and a guiding principle to travel with purpose. It reflects our belief that sharing extraordinary places comes with responsibility to care for the landscapes, cultures and communities that welcome us, ensuring our presence leaves a lasting positive impact.
The three pillars of Journey Lightly are:
People : Connecting with communities and culture
Place : Protecting our habitats and wildlife
Planet : Reducing our environmental footprint
Explore the region
Grapes for Good Wineries Langhorne Creek
If you care about animals and you love wine, there s never been a more exciting time to visit our four winery partners based in Langhorne Creek. Grab a bottle of our limited edition Grapes for Good wine each purchase directly contributes to Monarto Safari Park s conservation efforts.
Monarto Safari Park Monarto
Monarto Safari Park is the largest safari experience outside of Africa, and it s located right next door. Spanning over 1,500 hectares and home to more than 500 animals who happily roam their large open-range habitats. Guests of the Resort are able to access an exclusive discount for general admission entry, so there s no better time to explore.
Mannum Waterfalls Mannum
This popular bush walking destination offers tunning scenic views, an abundance of wildlife and fascinating geology. Good walking shoes and plenty of water is essential.
Hahndorf Adelaide Hills
Hahndorf is the oldest surviving German settlement in Australia, founded in 1839 and, over the years, has evolved into a true artisan village. Ambleside Distillers is a family-owned distillery in Hahndorf that produces award-winning gin including Wild Safari Gin.
The Bend Kartdome Tailem Bend
Race around The Bend s world class karting circuit in some of the fastest hire karts available in Australia. You don t need a license to enjoy all the fun and excitement of go-karting at The Bend s state of the art facility.
Mount Barker Summit Adelaide Hills
For panoramic views of the surrounding region, take the walking trail to the summit of Mount Barker. The 250m trail is an easy walk, passing a lookout area and picnic tables, or you can enjoy a scenic 2km circuit trail around the summit to discover important conservation areas protecting valuable biodiversity.

FAQS - Monarto Safari Resort
Search for:
Search Results
FAQS
What are the dining options? Is breakfast, lunch and dinner?
Take a seat at Kutjera Restaurant & Bar for a curated menu of contemporary Australian cuisine.
Breakfast: 7:00am – 10:00am
Lunch: 11:00am 3:00pm
Dinner: 5:00pm – 9:30pm
Pool Bar: from 11:00am
Is there a Day Spa?
Marula Day Spa features a signature menu of restorative therapies and nourishing beauty experiences. Our Day Spa features single and couple treatment rooms, vitality and plunge pools, and a sauna, and is open to both Resort guests and the general public.
The Day Spa is open 7 days a week 9:00am to 5:00pm. Any bookings outside of these hours are by appointment only.
Are the hotel room rates per night or per person? Are meals and activities included in the room rate?
Room rates for the hotel apply per night of your booking, and includes buffet breakfast.
Activities are not included in the hotel room rate. A URL link can be found in your booking confirmation email to add on exclusive tours or discounted entry to Monarto Safari Park to your upcoming stay.
Is there a minimum stay?
For the hotel, we currently require a 2-night minimum stay over Saturday night. There may also be seasonal periods where a minimum stay applies.
The minimum stay for a reservation at Safari Lodge is 2 nights.
Can I book an experience or discounted Park entry without staying at the Resort?
Our Wildlife Safaris and Tours are exclusively for our guests and are not available for those not staying at Monarto Safari Resort.
The discounted Monarto Safari Park General Admission ticket prices are only available to our guests. These can be purchased at the time of booking or from the Front Desk during your stay.
What animals will I be able to see from the Resort?
The waterhole is located incredibly close to the Resort, offering spectacular views of the Wild Africa animals as they come in to drink. Animals in this area include giraffe, zebra, eland, ostrich, nyala, oryx, blackbuck and barbary rams.
Is there a shuttle service from the Resort to Monarto Safari Park?
Guests will only be collected at the Resort for our exclusive Wildlife Safari experiences. For general admission to the Park, guests must self-drive. A Zoos SA vehicle will be available for transport to and from Monarto Safari Park at specific times in the morning and afternoon, however will only be available to those without their own means of transport. Please enquire about this service with Front Desk when checking in.
What time does the Sunset Wildlife Safari experience depart?
As the Sunset Wildlife Safaris are seasonal, your exact departure time will be communicated to you prior to your arrival or at check-in. Generally, these experiences will depart from Monarto Safari Resort 2.5 hours before sunset. Please note that this may be before the usual check-in time throughout the winter months.
How do I book an accessible room or interconnecting room?
Both accessible rooms and interconnecting rooms are available to book online by clicking the ‘book now’ button and following the prompts.
What facilities does Monarto Safari Resort have?
Premium resort accommodation
Luxury safari tents at Safari Lodge
Dining options including a restaurant and two bars
Luxurious day spa
Dynamic event spaces
Two breathtaking pools
Incredible views over the waterhole and surrounding Wild Africa plains
What are the best room types for families?
We have several 2-Bedroom Suites available as well as King/Twin interconnecting rooms.
Is there additional bedding available? How can I book a portacot or rollaway?
Portacots and rollaways can be booked through our Travel Centre and may incur a nightly charge. Each room can only accommodate one extra bedding item. Please note that availability is limited so pre-booking is essential.
Infant portacot: Free of charge, subject to availability
Rollaway bed: $60 per night
To add a portacot or rollaway to your booking, please call our Travel Centre.
Within Australia: 1800 016 761
Outside Australia: +61 8 7079 9990
What accessibility facilities are available at Monarto Safari Resort?
Monarto Safari Resort offers numerous facilities for guests with accessibility requirements to ensure a comfortable experience for all guests.
Wheelchair accessible rooms: Our Resort has specially designed rooms equipped with accessible features such as wider doorways, grab bars, and lowered facilities for ease of use.
Accessible parking: Designated accessible parking spaces are available near the entrance, with convenience access to the main building.
Accessible tours: The vehicles used for our Wildlife Safari experiences can accommodate guests with mobility needs. Our staff will assist as necessary to ensure a smooth and enjoyable experience.
Restrooms: Accessible restrooms are available throughout the resort and located within or close to our amenities (restaurant, day spa and pool).
Accessible pool: Our all-ages pool features a ramp into the shallow end, as well as a wheelchair lift.
Guide Dogs: Guide Dogs are allowed to stay at our Resort, but this must be communicated when booking and the required documentation provided.
Can I host an event at Monarto Safari Resort?
We’d love to host your special personal or corporate event at Monarto Safari Resort. Learn more about hosting an event with us.
Can I purchase a gift voucher? Can I redeem an existing Journey Beyond gift voucher for Monarto Safari Resort?
Gift vouchers can be purchased online . Journey Beyond gift vouchers are redeemable at all Journey Beyond experiences, including Monarto Safari Resort.
Gift vouchers can be redeemed when booking online or over the phone through our Travel Centre on 1800 016 761:
When booking online, select ‘Voucher’ under ‘Payment Details’. You will then be sent a booking confirmation via email which will have a payment link where you can pay using your voucher.

Your stay could look like...
Day One
When you arrive, you ll be greeted by our friendly Guest Experience team who will welcome you to Safari Lodge.
Following check-in, you will be escorted to your tent by one of our hosts who will give you an overview of what s included in your stay. Should you feel peckish, you will find a fully-stocked minibar or you can join us back at the lodge for canapes and drinks .
Indulge in a multi-course dinner in the lodge restaurant before retiring to your luxury tent, and falling asleep to the soothing sounds of nature.
Day Two
Wake up in the wild you may even see a zebra or giraffe from your deck before joining us at the lodge for a delicious breakfast .
Now the day is yours! As part of your stay, a multi-day pass to Monarto Safari Park is included. You could spend the day there, or perhaps you d like to treat yourself to a treatment at Marula Day Spa at the Hotel. If you re with us at the Lodge, you can enjoy an alfresco lunch of delicious local produce .
Before the sun goes down, hop aboard the open-sided Safari Landcruiser for our Wild Africa Safari where you will spend 2.5-hours traversing the precinct with a knowledgeable Monarto Safari Park guide.
Our daily canapes and drinks await you prior to another delicious multi-course dinner in the lodge restaurant.
Day Three
Good things fly by so quickly! Have a leisurely last lie-in and watch the animals graze at the neighbouring waterhole, and then join us at the lodge for breakfast .
Check-out is at 11am come back soon!
